paragraphs: Saltus Technologies sells digiTICKET, an eCitation solution designed for state and local government. digiTICKET replaces paper ticket books and transfers ticket data to Court and Records Management Systems. The software also provides photo capture, GPS mapping and enhanced reporting.

Agencies with only a few officers per shift use digiTICKET, as do departments such as the Kansas Highway Patrol and the New Orleans Police Department. Ticket formats include municipal ordinances, state statutes, traffic tickets, parking tickets and code enforcement violations. digiTICKET runs on devices using Windows, Android, and iOS operating systems, including ruggedized tablets and mobile phones.

The ticketing system can be interfaced with over 75 different CAD/RMS, State, and Court applications. It is configured to an agency's specific requirements and supported by a team of US based engineers. Saltus states that digiTICKET can be procured with zero up-front costs.

quote.text: digiTICKET is an eCitation solution designed for State and Local Government.
